title: an inherited name wins over an outer one, whichever is declared first
note: FIXED 2026-09-03 (I4). `W` is declared both in the supertype `Base` and in the enclosing package. KerML §8.2.3.5.3 makes the INHERITED membership the local resolution, so `w1` is typed by `P::Base::W` — and this file writes the outer `W` FIRST, which used to be the order that bound the wrong one.
